campuses.title: Dubai Media City Campus
campuses.text: Главный и единственный кампус AUD — ~1.3 млн кв. футов в Dubai Media City. Все шесть schools, библиотека, athletic facilities, health center, общежития.

paragraphs: American University in Dubai (AUD) is a private, non-sectarian institution of higher learning established in 1995 and located in Dubai Media City, United Arab Emirates. Founded by Elias Bou Saab in partnership with American Intercontinental University, AUD was created to bring an American-style higher education model to the Persian Gulf region.

AUD operates six academic divisions: the School of Business Administration, the School of Engineering, the Mohammed Bin Rashid School for Communication, the School of Architecture, Art and Design, the School of Arts and Sciences, and the Graduate School of Education. Its engineering school was established in 2001 in partnership with Georgia Institute of Technology.

The university holds dual accreditation: in the United States by the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Colleges (SACSCOC), and in the UAE by the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research. AUD is ranked in the QS World University Rankings (around 678 in 2026).

AUD's student body of approximately 1,800-2,000 students comes from more than 100 nationalities, reflecting Dubai's status as a global crossroads. The motto Get Life Ready captures AUD's emphasis on practical, career-ready education in a multicultural environment.
paragraphsRu: American University in Dubai (AUD) — частный негосударственный университет, основан в 1995 году в Dubai Media City, ОАЭ. Создан Elias Bou Saab совместно с American Intercontinental University, чтобы принести модель американского высшего образования в регион Персидского залива.

AUD состоит из шести академических подразделений: School of Business Administration, School of Engineering, Mohammed Bin Rashid School for Communication, School of Architecture, Art and Design, School of Arts and Sciences и Graduate School of Education. School of Engineering открыта в 2001 году совместно с Georgia Institute of Technology.

Университет имеет двойную аккредитацию: в США — Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Colleges (SACSCOC), в ОАЭ — Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research. AUD входит в QS World University Rankings (~678 в 2026).

В AUD учатся ~1 800–2 000 студентов более чем из 100 стран — отражение статуса Дубая как глобального перекрёстка. Девиз Get Life Ready подчёркивает практическую, career-ready подготовку в мультикультурной среде.
